nodes.label: Prompt to CadQuery generation pipeline (LLM -> AST check -> sandbox -> mesh validation)
nodes.rationale: The generated CadQuery code is kept as the single source of truth so refinements ('make it 10mm wider') edit code rather than meshes, producing exact watertight B-rep solids ready for the slicer.
nodes.norm_label: prompt to cadquery generation pipeline (llm -> ast check -> sandbox -> mesh validation)

nodes.label: Self-correction loop (3 attempts, traceback fed back to LLM)
nodes.rationale: Local models fail often enough that the orchestrator retries up to 3 times, returning the execution traceback to the LLM so it can repair its own script.
nodes.norm_label: self-correction loop (3 attempts, traceback fed back to llm)

nodes.label: AST allowlist + subprocess sandbox
nodes.rationale: Allowlist limits imports to cadquery/math/numpy with no I/O; sandbox is AST check + isolated subprocess + timeout. Explicitly pragmatic for a personal local tool, not a security boundary against a hostile model.

nodes.label: qwen2.5-coder:14b (code generation model)
nodes.rationale: Chosen as default PRINTCAD_MODEL_CODE because it fits in 16 GB VRAM (~9 GB); models >16 GB like qwen3.6 overflow VRAM.

nodes.label: qwen3-vl:8b (vision model for image-to-CAD)
nodes.rationale: Optional vision model; Ollama swaps it with the code model in VRAM automatically. Extracts a structured brief (part type, holes, proportions) that feeds generation; the user's text supplies real dimensions.

nodes.label: Organic mode (photo to neural mesh)
nodes.rationale: Exists for figures/sculptures that parametric CAD cannot express. Exports STL/3MF only: a neural mesh has no B-rep, so no STEP export and no 'View code'. Backend repairs the raw mesh (largest component, holes, normals) and rests it on the bed.

nodes.label: TRELLIS (Microsoft, default organic engine)
nodes.rationale: Roadmap item completed: TRELLIS replaced TripoSR as default for higher quality; ORGANIC_ENGINE=triposr reverts to the old engine.

nodes.label: Refine prompt template
nodes.rationale: Instructs the model to keep the design parametric - prefer changing or adding parameters over rewriting from scratch - so iterations stay stable and diffable.

nodes.label: Repair prompt template
nodes.rationale: Feeds the failed script plus its error back to the LLM, demanding a complete corrected script without changing design intent. Special-cases fillet/chamfer failures: remove the call entirely instead of retrying, because a valid model without fillets beats a broken one.

nodes.label: CadQuery system prompt (rules + cheat sheet + few-shots)
nodes.norm_label: cadquery system prompt (rules + cheat sheet + few-shots)

nodes.label: Strict output rules (one python block, result var, mm, UPPER_CASE params, z>=0)
nodes.rationale: Constrains LLM output so the sandbox can execute it deterministically: exactly one fenced python block, final solid in `result`, only cadquery/math/numpy imports (matches the AST allowlist), part resting on z=0 oriented for FDM printing, minimum wall 1.2 mm.
nodes.norm_label: strict output rules (one python block, result var, mm, upper_case params, z>=0)

nodes.label: CadQuery cheat sheet (API calls covering most functional parts)
nodes.rationale: Inlines the subset of the CadQuery 2.x API (box, extrude, hole, shell, union/cut, selectors, rarray) plus metric hole diameters so a local model does not hallucinate API signatures.
nodes.norm_label: cadquery cheat sheet (api calls covering most functional parts)

nodes.label: Fillet/chamfer rules (decorative, omit when in doubt)
nodes.rationale: Edge selectors like |Z match straight edges only; circular edges on cylinders need >Z/<Z and chamfers. Fillets are treated as decorative: after a fillet error the model should omit them, since fillet failures (BRep_API: command not done) are the most common OCCT crash mode.
nodes.norm_label: fillet/chamfer rules (decorative, omit when in doubt)

nodes.label: Few-shot examples (bracket, hub, L-bracket, box)
nodes.rationale: Four worked examples demonstrating the output contract; the L-bracket example explicitly teaches that an L-bracket is two perpendicular plates, correcting a common model misconception.

nodes.label: Vision analyze prompt (image to structured JSON brief)
nodes.rationale: Forces JSON-only output (part_type, overall dims, features, notes, detailed_description written for an engineer who cannot see the image). Dimensions are estimated from proportions and rescaled from one user-provided real dimension; the model must not invent features from shading or rendering artifacts.
nodes.norm_label: vision analyze prompt (image to structured json brief)

nodes.label: Frontend Vite + React + TypeScript template notes
nodes.norm_label: frontend vite + react + typescript template notes

nodes.label: Frontend HTML entry point (root div + main.tsx module)
nodes.norm_label: frontend html entry point (root div + main.tsx module)

nodes.label: PrintCAD Organic microservice (photo to neural mesh, port 8001)
nodes.rationale: Lives in its own uv project because its stack (PyTorch cu128, transformers) is heavy and incompatible with the main backend. Returns raw STL; the main backend repairs, scales and beds the mesh. Random seed per request, so resending the same photo yields variants.
nodes.norm_label: printcad organic microservice (photo to neural mesh, port 8001)

nodes.label: TRELLIS engine (image-large, default)
nodes.rationale: Default because quality is far superior; costs ~6 GB resident VRAM and ~1-2 min per piece on an RTX 5060 Ti. Vendored at pinned commit 442aa1e with the flexicubes submodule.

nodes.label: TripoSR engine (legacy, faster but less detailed)
nodes.rationale: Kept as fallback via ORGANIC_ENGINE=triposr, pinned at commit 107cefd; faster and lighter (~1.4 GB weights) but much less detailed.
nodes.norm_label: triposr engine (legacy, faster but less detailed)

nodes.label: Windows no-CUDA-compile shims (xformers, kaolin, torchmcubes, open3d stub)
nodes.rationale: TRELLIS officially requires flash-attn/xformers, kaolin, nvdiffrast. By using only the mesh output (no texturing/render) native deps shrink to spconv-cu126 (prebuilt wheel, PTX JIT for sm_120). Local shims: xformers reimplemented over torch native SDPA, kaolin reduced to check_tensor, torchmcubes replaced by scikit-image marching cubes, open3d stubbed in memory.
nodes.norm_label: windows no-cuda-compile shims (xformers, kaolin, torchmcubes, open3d stub)

nodes.label: Single-reconstruction lock (VRAM shared with Ollama)
nodes.rationale: One reconstruction at a time because the 16 GB VRAM is shared with Ollama; TRELLIS + qwen3-vl loaded together can OOM, in which case the user should unload the Ollama model first. Mesh is decimated to <=500k faces with fast-simplification before export.
